item.question: The following table shows the points scored by each player in four games: A: 14, 16, 10, 10. B: 0, 8, 6, 4. C: 8, 11, did not play, 13. (a) Find the average number of points scored per game by A. (b) To find the mean number of points scored per game by C, would you divide the total points by 3 or by 4? Why? What about B? (c) Who is the best performer?
steps_tex: $(b)$: $C$ did not play one game, so divide by $3$: $8 + 11 + 13 = 32$ and $32 \div 3 \approx 10.67$.
$B$ played all four games; the $0$ is a real score, so divide by $4$: $18 \div 4 = 4.5$.
$(c)$: $A$ has the highest mean, $12.5$, so $A$ is the best performer.
steps: (b) C did not play one game, so divide by 3: 8 + 11 + 13 = 32 and 32 ÷ 3 ≈ 10.67.
B played all four games; the 0 is a real score, so divide by 4: 18 ÷ 4 = 4.5.
(c) A has the highest mean, 12.5, so A is the best performer.
item.text:
$1$. $(a)$: $A$: $14 + 16 + 10 + 10 = 50$, so $50 \div 4 = 12.5$ points per game.
$2$. $(b)$: $C$ did not play one game, so divide by $3$: $8 + 11 + 13 = 32$ and $32 \div 3 \approx 10.67$.
$3$. $B$ played all four games; the $0$ is a real score, so divide by $4$: $18 \div 4 = 4.5$.
$4$. $(c)$: $A$ has the highest mean, $12.5$, so $A$ is the best performer.
Answer: $(a)$: $12.5$; $(b)$: $C$ by $3$, about $10.67$; $B$ by $4$, $4.5$; $(c)$: $A$

item.question: Find the 3-digit code from the five clues: 265 one right and in place; 271 one right but misplaced; 036 nothing right; 064 one right but misplaced; 542 two right but misplaced.
steps_tex: $036$ rules out $0$, $3$ and $6$.
$064$ then has only $4$ left, so $4$ is in the code but not in the last place.
$542$ says $4$ is not in the middle place either, so $4$ is first.
$265$ has one digit in place; $2$ cannot be first, so $5$ is correct in the last place.
$542$ has two correct digits, $5$ and $4$, so $2$ is out.
$271$ then needs $7$ or $1$ in a new place; only the middle is free, and $7$ is already in the middle there, so $1$ goes in the middle.
The code is $415$; check: it fits all five clues.
